description: Move a node in your durable memory to a different place in the tree. The first argument is the node's stem; --parent is the stem of the node it should sit under, or / for the top level. Its children move with it. Links to it keep working, because links go by stem and not by place. Use it when a node is right but filed in the wrong place. Example: ["atlas-cutover", "--parent", "<parent stem>"]. If the command exits with code 75 ("busy" or "changed on disk"), run the same command again.
